about: The small jobs of the crew. Three are open at a time. A finished job pays one part of gear and makes room for a new one on the next day, an unfinished job stays, and nothing is lost by not playing. Kind says what counts toward a job.

jobs.text: Find a drain you have never been to
Find three drains you have never been to
Meet a keeper that is new to you
Earn a seal with a well read throw
Uncover twenty new squares of the map
Uncover sixty new squares of the map
